text: Water is leaking from the bathroom ceiling and dripping on the floor.
The kitchen tap keeps dripping even when fully closed.
No water supply in our flat since morning.
The corridor light outside my door is flickering all night.
Sparks are coming out of the main switchboard in the hall.
Lift stuck between the 6th and 7th floor with two people inside.
The lift door takes very long to close and makes a grinding noise.
An unknown person was trying door handles on our floor at night.
The CCTV camera near the main gate has not been working for a week.
Garbage was not collected from our floor today.
There is a crack in the bedroom wall that is getting wider.
Lots of cockroaches in the kitchen, please arrange pest control.
Someone keeps parking a scooter in my allotted slot.
Loud music from the flat above every night after 11 pm.
There is a strong gas leak smell near the stairs on the third floor.
Please share the date of the next society general meeting.
Pani nahi aa raha subah se, tank khali hai shayad.
Ghar mein light nahi hai, sirf hamare flat mein power cut hai.
Lift mein phas gaye hain, darwaza nahi khul raha.
Seedhiyon pe bahut kachra pada hai, safai nahi hui.
Bagal wale flat mein raat ko bahut shor hota hai.
Switch chhoone pe current lag raha hai, bahut khatarnak hai.
बाथरूम की छत से पानी टपक रहा है।
रसोई में गैस की बदबू आ रही है, जल्दी आइए।
घर में बहुत मच्छर हैं, फॉगिंग करवा दीजिए।
मेरी पार्किंग की जगह पर कोई और गाड़ी खड़ी करता है।
स्वयंपाकघरातील नळ सतत गळत आहे.
लिफ्टमध्ये अडकलो आहोत, लवकर मदत पाठवा.
जिन्याजवळ गॅसचा वास येत आहे.
भिंतीला तडे गेले आहेत आणि ओल येत आहे.
